title: Zwambag 2020: L4/L5 external moment demand at flexion relaxation (measured) and model partition
condition: standing flexion; control, 2.3, 4.5, 6.8 kg counterweight at T5

quantity.name: L4/L5 extensor moment demand at LES inactivation
quantity.definition: MEASURED: external L4/L5 moment demand (inverse dynamics) at the instant the lumbar ES became inactive, mean +/- SEM. Rows tagged model_output are the authors' passive-tissue model partition, NOT data.

protocol.summary: Re-analysis of the Zwambag 2016 data set with a passive tissue model (48 muscle fascicles, 14 ligaments, disc).
how_to_simulate: Scale to protocol.subject_model (male, 25 y, 181 cm, 82 kg)
Quasi-static trunk flexion to full flexion (T12/S1 ~53 deg)
External load: an upward cable force at ~T5 equal to the counterweight (0, 22.2, 44.5, 66.7 N) via an overhead pulley; no hand load
Output: lumbar flexion, trunk inclination and the external L4/L5 moment at the instant the model's lumbar ES activation reaches ~0 (critical point)
protocol.notes: Surface EMG bilateral: lumbar ES at L3, thoracic ES at T9, latissimus at T12, RA 2 cm lateral to navel, EO 14 cm lateral to midline, IO 2 cm medial/inferior to ASIS; fine-wire multifidus 1.5 cm lateral to L1 and L4 spinous processes. EMG high-pass 100 Hz, rectified, 2.5 Hz low-pass, %MVIC. Critical point = LES activity crosses mean + 2 SD of its quiet (full-flexion) period for > 20 ms. Lumbar flexion = T12 vs S1 rigid bodies (0 = neutral standing); trunk inclination = T12 rigid body vs horizontal (0 = standing). L4/L5 moment from a 2-D dynamic bottom-up linked-segment model (force plate). Task: flex to full flexion in 3 s, hold 3 s, return in 3 s; counterweights 0/5/10/15 lb (0/2.3/4.5/6.8 kg) on a cable attached at ~T5 over an overhead pulley (reduces the flexion moment). Lumbar ES became inactive ~2-3 deg before full spine flexion (T12/S1 53 +/- 1.38 deg) in the control condition. Only the demand rows are targets.

data.x: lumbar flexion at FR (deg), control / 2.3 / 4.5 / 6.8 kg

extraction.from: Zwambag 2020 Table 1 and Results text p.4
extraction.check_notes: Table 1 checked against the page image; negative active moments (-5, -6 Nm) lost by pdftotext, restored from the image. verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (Table 1 and Results text p.4: demands, model partitions incl. negative active moments per footnote, flexion angles; SEM correctly labelled; n=10). Minor: text gives full flexion as 53 ± 1.38 deg on p.4 but 53 ± 1.8 deg on p.5; kept 1.38.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (angles); for SEM-reported data use SD = SEM x sqrt(n)
